task: Prevent frontend Git builds from overwriting the production audit Worker.
nonGoals: Redeploying the Worker, scoring changes, changing password or usage safeguards, changing the Pages preview or shared GitHub connection.

outcomes.description: The misconfigured production and frontend-preview Worker build triggers are removed while the verified production Worker stays active.
outcomes.evidence: Exact trigger inventory before and after, targeted API operations and unchanged active version/resources.

outcomes.description: The password endpoint accepts the configured credential and unauthenticated submissions and report reads remain rejected.
outcomes.evidence: Live status/CORS checks without starting an audit.

process.description: Commit the plan before changing infrastructure, independently review the exact correction, record actual effects and run required checks.
process.evidence: Git chronology, independent review and sanitized configuration verification.

styleEfficiency.description: Use the smallest correction consistent with the existing manual-release policy and retain a private configuration backup.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Two Worker-scoped triggers removed; no repository connection or service changes.

exitTest.reason: This corrects a remote application build attachment and documents the existing manual release rule. It does not change agent workflow, portability, memory or resumability.
